newsitem.title: UK: Euro oil swaps - Brent CFDs softer, others hold.
newsitem.headline: Euro oil swaps - Brent CFDs softer, others hold.

text.p: European oil swaps were steady to a touch softer on Friday morning. Brent CFDs softened while other swaps hovered broadly unchanged.

Brent CFDs weakened by a few cents with June 23-27 pegged around -31 cents against August compared with -24 cents while June 30-July 4 slipped to -35 cents from -27/28 cents. July 7-14 dipped to -37 cents against August from -30 and July 14-18 dropped to -35 cents from -30 cents.
Heavy fuel was holding steady, but the tone was bearish. July was around $81-82 with physical barges heard traded early at $79 and $79.50 before recovering to $81.

Gasoline and naphtha swaps business was slow with levels holding. July gasoline was pegged a touch over $181 and showing only a mild contango into September. Naphtha was also showing a $1 contango or so into August and September from July's 175.
